note: Deterministic concept-distribution markers for the LLM preference-alignment held-out fixture, frozen before the first LIVE request of M13.7.9. A section 'carries' a concept when every pattern group in `all` matches somewhere in that section's stripped text. Owner = the section designated by argumentUnitsV2 to explain it fully. Markers locate candidates; whether a hit is a harmful full re-explanation or a half-sentence reminder is decided by the classification layer and by reading. Markers are NOT widened after outputs are seen; misses are reported alongside manual counts.
